name: Static scatter (p308)
description: p308 Phase 1's verification scene: a flat 64 m terrain block whose scatter (scatterTestPebbles, its block's own) places 20,000 pebbles of two kinds by a test generator the scene registers, tinted per instance, in 16 m cells: one InstancedMesh entity per cell and kind, no entity per pebble. Each cell hides as a whole below its LOD's cullScreenSize (0.5): from the start camera the near half of the block shows and the far half is culled. Beside them, scatterTestBoulders places six hand-placed boulders (a PLACEMENTS source, spawnScatter on the block's centre), casting shadows. In front, one Blender Geometry Nodes scatter of two rocks (devTools/blender/buildScatterTest.py) twice, from IMPORTED sources: exported with GPU Instances on the left (scatterTestGnGpu), as a point cloud on the right (scatterTestGnPoints); the load checks they place the same rocks the same way. The load checks the counts and, a few frames in, that some cells are LOD-culled and some aren't, logging an error otherwise. Behind it, p308 Phase 3's rules block (scatterTestRulesBlock, a rulesTerrain block: rock on its slopes, sand on its flats) carries two scatters by the toolkit's terrainScatter: pebbles masked to the rock layer and slabs on the sand with CONVEXHULL colliders; the load checks the pebbles follow the rock, that a second spawn places them the same, a collider per slab, and that a box dropped on a slab rests on its top. window.__scatterTest holds the spawn results.
